name: RTK Bridge
description: Routes the AI agent's git, npm, docker and other tool commands through RTK (Rust Token Killer) for 60-90% token savings, shows a status-bar indicator when it is active, and tells the agent so it never has to go looking. Configurable per project via .tedi/rtk.json. RTK must be installed on PATH separately.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com
